name: Keshisumi
source:
One of the fox maidens dwelling in the vicinity of the hot spring inn “Fox Grove”.

A supernatural fox classified as a “sky fox”. She has a spoiled and mischievous personality.

[From [url=https://gyutto.com/i/item9240/af-765?af_type=1&select_uaflag=1]Gyutto[/url]]
